items:
Welcome to 'Coastal Blessings on 30A,' where laid-back coastal charm meets refined luxury. This thoughtfully designed retreat is the perfect sanctuary for families and friends looking to unwind and reconnect along Florida's scenic 30A.

Step inside and be greeted by an open-concept living area, curated with upscale coastal furnishings, elegant finishes, and an abundance of natural light that instantly makes you feel at home. The kitchen is fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, a spacious island for entertaining, and everything you need to craft unforgettable meals with loved ones. Whether you're gathering for a family breakfast or an evening cocktail hour, the seamless flow between the kitchen, dining, and living spaces ensures every moment is shared in comfort and style. Mornings are best spent savoring a cup of coffee on the serene screened-in porch, surrounded by the soft sounds of nature and Gulf breezes. As the sun sets, gather around the outdoor fire pit for evenings filled with conversation, laughter, and a touch of coastal magic.

Enjoy the golf cart and six adult bikes to make beach days effortless. Stroll down to the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Emerald Coast just 0.7 miles away or explore the nearby boutique shops and upscale dining at 30Avenue, a hub of local flavor and style. For your convenience, the home is fully stocked with premium beach gear, including chairs, umbrellas, a wagon, and coolers, so you can spend less time packing and more time making memories. After a day in the sun, retreat to the community pool, located just a short walk from the home, for a refreshing dip in a peaceful setting.

HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
-5 minutes to the Gulf
-Community pool
-6 adult bikes
-Golf cart
-2 dedicated parking spots
-Gas grill
-Gas fire pit
-Full washer/dryer
-Gaming counsel
-Beach gear
-Private fenced in yard
-Game room with Pac-Man second floor loft
-Fully stocked kitchen including additional kitchen appliances
-Hammock in backyard
-Water feature fountain
-Inlet Beach access is a short walk
-30Avenue .4 miles
-Rosemary & Alys beach are a short bike ride

ACCOMMODATIONS
Coastal Blessings on 30A comfortably accommodates up to 12 people:

First Floor:
-Bedroom 1: King, Ensuite Bathroom

Second Floor:
-Bedroom 2: (2) Queen, Ensuite Bathroom
-Bedroom 3: King, Ensuite Bathroom
-Bedroom 4: (2) Queen, Ensuite Bathroom

**WHAT WE OFFER**

A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES:
Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels

WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water

PARKING
There are two parking spaces in the driveway. Additional parking spaces are available by the community pool.

LOCATION
Home is located in Inlet Beach, within The Preserve at Inlet Beach - A coastal community just 0.7 miles away from Inlet Beach access points and less than five minutes to the heart of Rosemary Beach. It's located directly behind the new, upscale shopping and dining center - 30Avenue, and close proximity to Rosemary Beach. The home is also just a short drive to Publix grocery store.

This neighborhood is a mix of full/part-time residents and vacation rentals. It's very quiet and friendly!

The community features a superb outdoor pool with a pavilion, seating, and and outdoor fireplace. The community boardwalk & dock provides direct access to Powell Lake should you wish to rent paddle boards or kayaks during your stay.

NEARBY BEACH ACCESS
Inlet Beach has several beach access options to choose from. Below are the 3 most popular:

-Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access: This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. Located 0.8 miles from house.

-Wall Street Beach Access: Located about a mile drive from the Preserve at Inlet Beach, about 200 yards east of the intersection of US30A and Highway 98, at the end of South Wall Street, where it dead ends at the gulf. NOTE: This Access has no public parking. There is no parking but there is parking, along with restrooms and outdoor showers about 1/4 mile east at the Inlet Beach Access.

-Winston Lane Public Beach Access: Located less than .08 away. This access is on the western border of Inlet Beach where it meets Rosemary. There is not public parking available, but plenty of bike racks if you choose to ride a bike.

HOUSE RULES
*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM
*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.
*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.
*No parties or events.
*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL
All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver's license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
